items.title: Kimchi Stew 🍲
items.fact: Kimchi stew is rich in fibre and warms you up.
narration: I'm Halmoni, let's cook together. Look closely at the ingredients.
First, heat some oil in a pot, then add the kimchi. Next, add the pork and tofu.
Now, add the gochujang and garlic, and stir well. Bring the stew to a boil.
Kimchi stew is not only delicious, but also gentle on the stomach. It's a traditional Korean dish.
Thanks for cooking with me, see you tomorrow for more recipes. Look closely for new videos.
items.description:
Learn how to make a delicious and traditional Korean kimchi stew with Halmoni. The ingredients include kimchi, pork, tofu, gochujang, and garlic. What's your favorite way to eat kimchi stew? Share with us in the comments.

Today's grandma wisdom: Kimchi stew is rich in fibre and warms you up.

items.title: Stormy Dance 🌪
items.fact: Thunderstorms on Earth can be thousands of times stronger than those on Mars.
items.activity: watching a thunderstorm safely from the porch
narration: What's the wildest weather in our universe?
I love watching thunderstorms from my cozy porch!
Che bello! The thunder is like a big drumbeat!
Did you know thunderstorms on Earth are much stronger than those on Mars?
Stay curious, stay safe, and we'll see you tomorrow!

items.title: Teddy's Boo Boo 🐻
items.fact: The human body can heal itself with the help of white blood cells fighting infection.
items.activity: putting a bandage on a scraped teddy bear (pretend doctor)
narration: What helps our body heal when we get a boo boo?
I'm playing doctor with my teddy bear friend.
Just like our skin heals, our bones can mend too.
White blood cells are like little warriors that fight off the bad guys.
Shall we find out more tomorrow?
